Hear pump.fun, live.

Every trade on pump.fun becomes a note, in time with Solana's slots. Big trades sound deep, small ones ring high. Buyers in control make the key brighter, sellers make it darker.

  • Buy bell
  • Sell plucked string
  • Graduated coin electric piano
  • New coin sparkle
  • Graduation string swell
  • Slot clock 4 slots = 1 beat
Data source

Sound starts after your click (browser rule). The free public endpoint is rate-limited and not meant for production; if it refuses or drops, try again later, use the demo, or paste your own endpoint. Click a bubble to open the coin. Not financial advice.
